# A bill whose only entry is booked to income, applying a split on an expense
# account it never posted to.
#
# The bill posts to `Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD` and
# `Income:Vendor Rebates USD` and to nothing else. The split it applies is on
# `Expenses:Supplies:USD`, which is somebody else's cost.
#
# It must be refused, and the refusal must not offer the posting as a way out.
# There is no account of that posting a split could be moved off: the payable
# already holds settlements, and income is refused whichever record posts to
# it.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming the expense account, with the
# transaction untouched.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-01-01 open Income:Vendor Rebates USD
  type: Income
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

bill "BILL-REBATE-002"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-02-24
  entry:
    date: 2026-02-24
    description: "Rebate"
    account: "Income:Vendor Rebates USD"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-02-24
    due: 2026-03-24
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-REBATE-002"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-02-10
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Due From Director USD"
    txn_guid: "aa11bb22cc33dd44ee55ff6677889900"
    txn_split_guid: "bb22cc33dd44ee55ff6677889900aa11"
